title: Sean Payton has a simple request to get Broncos QB Bo Nix back on track

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton has a simple request to get Broncos QB Bo Nix back on track
sources.description: Denver Broncos quarterback Bo Nix said he's been "overanalyzing and overthinking things" this season. His coach has a simple instruction to fix that.
